# docker_system_df (Data Source)

Reads disk usage by images, containers, volumes and build cache on the provider's Docker host (`GET /system/df`), like `docker system df`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_system_df" "usage" {}

output "reclaimable_bytes" {
  value = {
    images      = data.docker_system_df.usage.df.image_usage.reclaimable
    containers  = data.docker_system_df.usage.df.container_usage.reclaimable
    volumes     = data.docker_system_df.usage.df.volume_usage.reclaimable
    build_cache = data.docker_system_df.usage.df.build_cache_usage.reclaimable
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `verbose` (Boolean) Include the per-object `items` lists (`docker system df -v`). Default `false`: only the counts and sizes.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) sha256 of df_json.
- `df` (Attributes) The GET /system/df response as a nested object, field by field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--df))
- `df_json` (String) The Engine API GET /system/df response as JSON; with verbose, each Items list sorted by ID (volumes by Name). Re-encoded, not byte-exact: the moby client keeps no raw body for this call, so this is the decoded response written as canonical JSON (keys sorted, compact).
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version from GET /version.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion).
- `id` (String) ID of the daemon the usage was read from (`ID` in `GET /info`).

### Nested Schema for `df`

Read-Only:

- `build_cache_usage` (Attributes) Upstream `BuildCacheUsage`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--df--build_cache_usage))
- `container_usage` (Attributes) Upstream `ContainerUsage`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--df--container_usage))
- `image_usage` (Attributes) Upstream `ImageUsage`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--df--image_usage))
- `volume_usage` (Attributes) Upstream `VolumeUsage`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--df--volume_usage))

<a id="nestedatt--df--build_cache_usage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `df.build_cache_usage`

Read-Only:

- `active_count` (Number) Upstream `ActiveCount`.
- `items` (List of String) Upstream `Items`. Each element is canonical JSON (keys sorted, as upstream): no nested fields are fixed here and Terraform allows no dynamic value inside a list, set or map.
- `reclaimable` (Number) Upstream `Reclaimable`.
- `total_count` (Number) Upstream `TotalCount`.
- `total_size` (Number) Upstream `TotalSize`.
